test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the correct type of pronoun in the following sentence.

I enjoyed myself during the holidays.

Here, Myself is a ________ pronoun.
solution:
The correct answer is '**1) reflexive**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **reflexive pronoun** is used when the subject and the object of the sentence are the same person or thing.
 
• In the given sentence, "**myself**" refers back to the subject "**I**."
 
• Reflexive pronouns are formed by adding "-self" (singular) or "-selves"
